# Labels an issue form in this directory is permitted to declare, one per line
# (blank lines and #-comments ignored). This is the reviewed source of truth for
# the "declared labels resolve" check: a form may only apply a label listed here.
#
# Why a committed list and not `gh label list`: the live label set is mutable
# state no pull request can observe, so a label renamed or removed elsewhere
# (e.g. by the weekly label-sync normalising a case) would turn an unrelated
# push red. Listing the permitted labels here catches a drift in the diff that
# introduces it, and a rename becomes a reviewed edit to both the form and this
# file in one change.
#
# The canonical entries (bug, enhancement, documentation) are guaranteed to
# exist by the shared label-sync (.github/workflows/labels.yml); parse-error is
# a repository-specific label kept in step with 2-parse-error.yml. Add a line
# here in the same PR that teaches a form to declare a new label.
bug
enhancement
documentation
parse-error
